route_accounting_note: RELEASE-INDEX routes count what markets OWN; SERVED SITEMAP routes count what the composed bundle publishes. The difference on each side is the release-global surface no market owns (the apex, the category root, the editorial and legal pages and the market directory). It is the same set before and after, which is why the served delta equals Salt Lake City's owned-route delta plus its own policy-comparison page.

cross_market_collision_safety.KNOWN_LATENT_RISK: a bare-chain-shaped verified-no-pets exclusion name is matched by name in every market and could shadow a future, unrelated hotel of the same name; recorded, not repaired, by the founder's order

release_factory_accounting.note: REUSE counts live market index entries carried into the candidate unchanged. The whole-site composer has no populated release store in this worktree, so it physically renders every participating market's fragment; that count is PHYSICAL_FRAGMENTS_RERENDERED and is not reuse.
